unique_contribution: The ONLY source of protein-level below-detection observations: 56 enzymes with no product across >=8 conditions, plus 128 positives, under one protocol with blanks, an LCC-ICCG positive control and an RFP non-enzyme control. PAZy ingested only the 99 positives from this same paper and none of the negatives.
ml_usefulness: PRIMARY. Supplies both classes for a condition-specific classifier; near-balanced at cryPow/40 C (114/98).
other_research_usefulness: Condition-response analysis (positive rate 53.5% -> 0% across the grid), Tm for 234 sequences, replicate reproducibility, expression yield.
limitations: Effective n is 69 families, not 212; largest family = 40% of data. Measurements are floored at 0.03 mM and rounded to 0.01. Round/family/selection are confounded; RND3 was model-selected. 18 positives are marginal.

unique_contribution: 480 amino acid sequences not present in any original source; the engineered-variant space (IsPETase, LCC, TfCut2, PES-H1, PET2, SbPETase scaffolds).
ml_usefulness: NOT for training labels. Valid as an independent validation scaffold set: 0 exact overlap with the SI library, median 63% identity, only 2 of 212 above 95%.
other_research_usefulness: HIGH. Mutation-effect analysis, conserved motif work (GxSxG), PCA/clustering, similarity network, protein family relationships.
limitations: Collapses to 27 families at 70% identity; 243 records in one family. Severe publication bias toward scaffolds that already worked. Labels must come from PAZy/literature, not the uncalibrated Activity column.
recommendation: KEEP - Model validation, if scientifically justified; KEEP - Exploratory or biological analysis

unique_contribution: 711 protein x study activity measurements and 25 sheets of Tm/dTm across 33 published studies; within-study ordinal rankings.
ml_usefulness: LIMITED for the main task. Cannot be pooled: no units recorded anywhere, ranges irreconcilable (0.01-1.1 vs 15.9-4055), several normalised to different reference enzymes. Usable as rank-within-study for a separate mutation-effect model. Note the paper's 'lit. supervised' model, trained on literature data of this kind, reached 0.87-0.93 AUROC on the 2025 screen - so transfer is demonstrated, but it needs careful within-study normalisation.
other_research_usefulness: HIGH for biological interpretation: which mutations raise activity or Tm, scaffold engineering history.
limitations: No units, no conditions, no enzyme loading or reaction time recorded. 32 zero-activity rows are mutant-level negatives under each study's own unreported protocol - not poolable into one negative class.
recommendation: KEEP - Exploratory or biological analysis; OPTIONAL - Limited additional value for primary ML

dataset: Cui et al, 2021 (NanoPET).xlsx sheets Abacus / FoldX / Rosetta_ddg / Consensus
ml_usefulness: NONE - these are predictions, not measurements.
other_research_usefulness: Can be used to compare computational predictions against measured dTm, as a methods discussion.
limitations: Must never be counted as experimental evidence or enter training or test sets.
recommendation: EXCLUDE FROM MODELLING - Unsuitable or unreliable labels

unique_contribution: 263 library sequences with full amino acid sequence and expression data that were never assayed.
other_research_usefulness: Useful for discussing the expression bottleneck in enzyme discovery.
limitations: DECISIVE: these were not assayed because they failed to express (median 0.044 mg/mL vs 0.568 for assayed; ranges barely overlap, 4 at or below zero). Ranking them as 'promising untested candidates' would recommend proteins that already failed the first laboratory step.
recommendation: OPTIONAL - Limited additional value; use only with the expression caveat stated

unique_contribution: 5058 PET assays / 8439 measurements over 311 proteins and 83 publications, each with conditions, detection methods and a DOI.
ml_usefulness: Positive class and condition metadata. Cannot supply negatives: 303 of 311 proteins have a positive value and none has an all-zero record. Curation admits only published actives.
other_research_usefulness: HIGH - the provenance backbone, temperature analysis, literature linkage.
limitations: Positive-unlabelled by construction. 69 distinct units and 14 metric types - usable only after filtering to one metric and unit. Already contains the 2025 paper (99 proteins), the main leakage trap.
recommendation: KEEP - Exploratory or biological analysis; KEEP - Candidate discovery (nearest-characterised-relative annotation)

unique_contribution: 329 records (311 unique) with name-based annotation; 2535 organism-level degradation rows with evidence type.
ml_usefulness: LOW. Annotation, not measurement. 2008 of 2535 degrader rows have no sequence at all.
other_research_usefulness: Organism and ecology context, evidence-type discussion, data-provenance teaching material.
limitations: Name-based annotation; some NA accessions; 399 rows flagged as degradation extrapolated from enzyme; 99 rows already cite the 2025 paper.

unique_contribution: 3 reviewed reference cutinases with protein-level evidence (PE=1).
other_research_usefulness: Reference anchors for alignment and motif work.
limitations: Too small to affect any statistic.
